results.title: AI After Death: Digital Identity, Neural Echoes, and Post ...
results.content: # AI After Death: Digital Identity, Neural Echoes, and Post-Mortem Decision Rights This paper explores the philosophical and legal dimensions of post-mortem digital identity and decision rights in a world where “neural echoes” – AI-generated avatars, chatbots, and other memory-based simulations – can mimic the deceased. We also examine how major religious and cultural worldviews, from Christianity and Islam to Hinduism and Buddhism, shape societal norms and legal attitudes toward digital afterlife and “virtual immortality.” Through interdisciplinary analysis combining case studies, emerging technologies, and ethical theory, we discuss challenges such as the persistence of one’s digital persona after death, the use of AI to sustain the memory or likeness of the deceased, and conflicts between preserving legacy and ensuring dignity and privacy. Keywords: digital afterlife; post-mortem privacy; digital identity; AI avatars; neural echoes; digital inheritance; griefbots; memorialization; data protection; posthumous rights; philosophy of identity; transhumanism; digital estate planning; religious perspectives on technology
